title: CardProfile
description: tscore.card_profile/1: one observer scorecard design, so the scan desk can read it: its size, rows, value columns, how the card is found in the picture, how observers mark it, how they correct a mark, the reading thresholds, and how far its readings are trusted. Presets live in presets/card-profiles/. Profiles contain no rider data.

id.description: Profile id, stored in the event setup's event.card_profile, e.g. regional-16.

name.description: What the desk sees, naming the card.

card.description: The card's outside size, in millimetres, held upright (header at the top).

rows.description: Section rows on the card. A class can't ride more sections per lap than this.

grid.description: How the rows and cells are measured. Distances are in the grid's unit.

unit.description: column-width: multiples of the black section column's width, across from its centre line and up from the bottom of the last row (the black-column locator). Other units come with other locators.

row_pitch.description: Expected row height; the reader searches 15% either side of it.

cell_radius.description: Radius of the mark-sized area measured in each cell.

columns.description: The value columns, left to right, each with the score it stands for. Any order; a card without a 5 simply has no 5 column. At least three, so a correction can be told from a mark.

locator.description: How the card is found in the picture. black-column: the solid black section column (regional-16). card-edges, corner-markers, manual-corners: not read yet.

marking_style.description: How observers mark a score. punch: a hole punched through the card. pen-hole: a hole made with a pen. ink: a mark in ink. Each is read as change from the blank card, so the printed digit never counts as a mark; each has its own starting thresholds.

correction_rules.description: How observers correct a mark. inverse-all-but-one: every value but the right one is marked. none: no corrections; more than one mark is flagged. crossed-out: a mark is crossed out (read like none until the rule is set from real corrected cards).

trust.description: trusted: clearly read cards are saved by themselves. assisted: tScore suggests the reading and a person confirms every card.

blank_image.description: A straightened photo of a blank card (no rider data), relative to this file.

score.description: The score a mark in this column stands for.

across.description: The cell's centre across the card, in the grid's unit (negative = left of the column).

Thresholds.description: Reading thresholds, and the cards they were tuned on.

mark.description: A cell changed from the blank card by more than this (0 = as blank, 1 = as dark as the reference black right across the cell) counts as marked.

confidence_gap.description: How clearly marked and unmarked cells in a row must differ (0–1); below this a person decides the row.

colour_channel.description: Which colour the reader measures change in. luma: ordinary brightness, which sees black, blue and red ink. For ink, one colour can be chosen instead: red sees blue ink most strongly, but not red ink.

TunedFrom.description: The cards the thresholds were tuned on, and how well they read.

source.description: synthetic: cards drawn by tScore's test card generator. real: photos of real cards (kept privately, never shipped).

rows_read.description: Share of rows read with a score (0–1); the rest went to a person.

wrong_auto_accepts.description: Rows read with the wrong score. Must be 0 for a trusted profile.
